content: Godot command line headless uses headless display and Dummy audio; unknown flags may silently do nothing. Input action_press does not invoke Input callbacks; parse_input_event simulates input events. Global Input polling is unaffected by GUI handled-event state. Project inference: headless logic, rendered screenshots, actual keyboard UI paths, and real hardware performance need separate evidence. Fixed setup/ticks do not establish cross-platform bit-identical physics. Sources: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/editor/command_line_tutorial.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_input.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/inputs/inputevent.html
